points.label: Water
points.left: Flood destruction will not recur in the same way.
points.right: Waters of Noah are recalled as precedent.

points.label: Sign / stability
points.left: Rainbow is the sign named in Genesis.
points.right: Mountains and hills become the instability contrast in Isaiah.

points.label: Covenant wording
points.left: Covenant is with Noah, descendants, creatures, earth.
points.right: The phrase “covenant of peace” is used in restoration promise.

rightEvidence.title: Noah becomes a comparison for covenant peace

payload.tension: Isaiah explicitly recalls Noah while speaking a covenant of peace, but the prophetic address changes the audience, setting, and announced form of security.
